verdict.rationale: Agent Studio is a built-in AI capability that turns a short use-case description into a call-ready voice agent, so users can hand off agent creation without prompt engineering (bolna-docs-29). That is one narrow task, not a general in-product assistant. The MCP server lets external assistants act on the account, but it is not built into the product, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating tasks beyond agent creation (e.g. managing calls, batches, analytics), documentation of Studio's interaction model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
